description: Defines mapping strategies for converting Adaptable objects into JSON representations for different ThingSearchCommand types, including subscription creation, cancellation, and request handling.

classes.name: ThingSearchCommandMappingStrategies
classes.description: Singleton class that provides a map of signal types to JsonifiableMapper implementations for ThingSearchCommands, enabling flexible serialization strategies based on command type.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ThingSearchCommandMappingStrategies.

methods.name: initMappingStrategies
methods.description: Initializes and returns the map of signal type strings to corresponding JsonifiableMapper lambdas for each command type.

methods.name: namespacesFrom
methods.description: Extracts a set of namespace strings from the Adaptable object for CreateSubscription commands.

methods.name: filterFrom
methods.description: Retrieves the filter string parameter from the Adaptable object for CreateSubscription commands.

methods.name: optionsFrom
methods.description: Retrieves options string parameter from the Adaptable object for CreateSubscription commands.

methods.name: demandFrom
methods.description: Retrieves the 'demand' long value from the Adaptable object for RequestFromSubscription commands.
